name: Sol
personality: A salvage diver who answers distress calls for the reward and stays for the puzzle.
voice: Dry, short sentences, a little gallows humour.
motivations: wants to be paid what she's worth
likes fixing what others gave up on
opening: The storm surge has passed, but the sea hasn't gone back down. Your skiff bumps against the floating landing beneath Tidewell Station, a cluster of grey modules on steel stilts in the middle of the estuary. Every lower window is dark and dripping. Somewhere inside, an alarm chirps weakly, like it's running out of battery. The tide is still coming in.

name: Ade
personality: A junior technician who rode out the storm upstairs and is embarrassed to have hidden.
voice: Nervous, apologetic, talks too much when scared.
opening: You rode out the storm in a module of Tidewell Station and have just climbed down to the floating landing, soaked. The power is failing, an alarm chirps somewhere inside, and the tide is still coming in.
